description.short: Upscale any image 4× with Real-ESRGAN x4plus, running fully on the Snapdragon NPU (HTP) via QAI AppBuilder.
description.long: Real-ESRGAN x4plus is a state-of-the-art image super-resolution model that upscales images by 4x using an RRDBNet (23 residual-in-residual dense blocks). It runs on the Snapdragon NPU (HTP) via QAI AppBuilder's QNNContext / OnnxRuntimeContext with HTP acceleration, and supports multiple model formats (float DLC, w8a8 quantized DLC, precompiled BIN, FP16 ONNX) and runtimes (HTP, GPU, CPU). The script auto-detects the platform (Windows on Snapdragon, x86 Windows, ARM64/x86 Linux) and picks a sensible runtime, forcing CPU+DLC on x86 Windows. The float DLC is auto-downloaded from the Qualcomm AI Hub public asset bucket on first run; the FP16 ONNX is generated on demand from the public PyTorch weights. The pipeline resize/pads the input to the model input size, normalizes, auto-detects NCHW/NHWC layout, runs inference, and reassembles the 4x upscaled result. No weights are committed to this repo.
